name: Failed Logins
query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType != 0
| summarize FailedAttempts = count() by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
| where FailedAttempts > 2
| order by FailedAttempts desc
description: Find repeated failed sign-ins grouped by user and IP.
useCase: Brute force, credential stuffing or password spray triage.

name: Password Spray
query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType != 0
| summarize Attempts = count() by IPAddress
| where Attempts > 3
| order by Attempts desc
description: Find source IPs generating repeated failed sign-ins.
useCase: Identify a single source testing credentials across identities.

name: Multiple Failures Then Success
query:
SigninLogs
| where UserPrincipalName == "admin@example.com"
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country, Device, Result, MFAUsed
| order by TimeGenerated asc
description: Review a suspicious sequence of failures followed by a success.
useCase: Potential credential compromise after repeated authentication failures.

name: Risky Admin Sign-in
query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == 0
| where UserPrincipalName has_any ("admin", "tom")
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country, Device, MFAUsed, RiskLevel
| order by TimeGenerated desc
description: Review successful sign-ins from admin-like accounts.
useCase: Privileged account compromise and suspicious admin access.

name: Suspicious Role Assignment
query:
AuditLogs
| where Category == "RoleManagement"
| where OperationName == "Add member to role"
| project TimeGenerated, InitiatorUPN, TargetUPN, NewValue, Risk
| order by TimeGenerated desc
description: Surface new Entra role assignments and their initiator.
useCase: Privilege escalation and persistence through directory role assignment.

name: Impossible Travel Review
query:
SigninLogs
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Country, City, IPAddress, Result
| order by UserPrincipalName asc
description: Review sign-in geography per user for impossible travel patterns.
useCase: Potential stolen credentials used from distant geographies.

name: Public Management Port Exposure
query:
AzureActivity
| where OperationName has "securityRules/write"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, ResourceGroup, Resource, Details, Risk
| order by TimeGenerated desc
description: Find NSG rule changes that may expose management ports.

name: Privileged MFA Gap
query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType == 0
| where MFAUsed == false
| where UserPrincipalName has_any ("admin", "tom")
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country, AppDisplayName, RiskLevel
| order by TimeGenerated desc
description: Find successful privileged-looking sign-ins without MFA.
